Class ExprToTPTP

java.lang.Object
com.articulate.sigma.parsing.ExprToTPTP
public class ExprToTPTP extends Object
Translates Expr trees to TPTP format (FOF or TFF).

This is the Expr-based counterpart of {link com.articulate.sigma.trans.SUMOformulaToTPTPformula#processRecurse(Formula, String)}. All structural traversal is done by switching on sealed Expr subtypes; no string-based parsing or ANTLR context objects are involved.

Key mapping

   SUO-KIF                 TPTP FOF
   ───────────────────     ─────────────────────────────────────
   ?Var / @Row             V__Var / V__Row   (TERM_VARIABLE_PREFIX)
   SymbolName              s__SymbolName     (TERM_SYMBOL_PREFIX)
   relName (as arg)        s__relName__m     (+TERM_MENTION_SUFFIX for relations)
   (not A)                 ~(A)
   (and A B C)             (A invalid input: '&' B invalid input: '&' C)
   (or  A B C)             (A | B | C)
   (=> A B)                (A => B)
   (invalid input: '<'=> A B)               ((A => B) invalid input: '&' (B => A))
   (equal A B)             (A = B)
   (forall (?X) B)         ! [V__X] : (B)
   (exists (?X) B)         ? [V__X] : (B)
   (pred A B)              s__pred(A,B)
   free variables          wrapped in outer ! [...] : or ? [...]

    • relationsThreadLocal

      public static final ThreadLocal<Set<String>> relationsThreadLocal
      Thread-local snapshot of the KB relations set. Set this to kb.kbCache.relations before translating a batch of formulas so that shouldAddMention(java.lang.String, java.lang.String) can do a single O(1) HashSet.contains() instead of the per-atom KB.isRelationInAnyKB(java.lang.String) call (which iterates all KBs on every atom). Remove it in the finally block after the batch to avoid cross-request contamination.

      When null (the default), falls back to the original per-atom KB lookup so callers that don't set the snapshot continue to work correctly.

  • Method Details

    • translateKifString

      public static String translateKifString(String kif, boolean query, String lang)
      Parse a KIF string via ANTLR, build an Expr tree, and translate it to TPTP. This is the primary entry point when the caller has only a KIF string rather than a pre-built Expr (e.g. after preProcess/renameVariableArityRelations in SUMOKBtoTPTPKB).

      Returns null when the string cannot be parsed (ANTLR produces no result); the caller should fall back to the legacy string-based translator in that case.

      Parameters:
      kif - the KIF formula string
      query - true for query mode
      lang - "fof" or "tff"
      Returns:
      TPTP string, or null on parse failure

    • getQlist

      public static StringBuilder getQlist(String kif)
      Return a comma-separated list of TPTP variable names for the free variables in the given KIF formula string. Returns an empty StringBuilder if the string cannot be parsed or has no free variables.

      This mirrors the side-effect of SUMOformulaToTPTPformula.tptpParseSUOKIFString(java.lang.String, boolean) that sets its qlistTL ThreadLocal, but without requiring that legacy path to run.

    • getQlist

      public static StringBuilder getQlist(Expr expr)
      Fast-path overload: return a comma-separated list of TPTP variable names for the free variables in an already-parsed Expr tree.

      Use this when the caller already holds a pre-built Expr (e.g. from Formula.expr) to avoid redundant ANTLR re-parsing. Produces the same result as getQlist(String) for the same formula.

      Parameters:
      expr - the pre-built expression tree; null is handled safely
      Returns:
      comma-separated TPTP variable list (e.g. "V__X,V__Y"), or an empty StringBuilder if there are no free variables

    • collectFreeVars

      public static Set<String> collectFreeVars(Expr expr)
      Collect all variables that appear free (unbound by any quantifier) in the given expression. The result is a LinkedHashSet to preserve depth-first traversal order — matching {link Formula#collectUnquantifiedVariables()}.
